description: Allowlisted eng skills for agent-m1 / Claude Code / Codex (amillez plugin pack). Device root = core (+ optional argent). Project mobile/native skills are curated and committed in-repo when needed. No ~/.codex. Cursor plugin / My Machines out of scope.

core.description: Always installed at ~/.claude + ~/.agents: grill-me + first-party orchestration/verification/models setup + user rules + stamp

argent.description: Optional device/host Argent skills for UI drive (agent-m1). Not installed by default with core. Pass --groups core,argent. Also install Argent CLI separately.

project.description: Curated mobile/native skills copied into <project>/.claude/skills and .agents/skills when the app needs them (committed, shared). Use scripts/add-project-skills.sh — do not dump the whole set.

upstream.note: Optional device group. Pin ref when upgrading @swmansion/argent CLI. Not installed by default with core.

upstream.when: Reviewing / critiquing animation and motion (Emil craft bar)
upstream.note: Upstream sets disable-model-invocation: true — not auto-invoked; launch prompts must name it explicitly for critique passes.

upstream.when: Writing, reviewing, or debugging any React Native or Expo code
Building or debugging Uniwind className styling in RN

firstParty.when: Fan out large work into parallel isolated agent prompts (Codex/Claude/mixed workers OK)
Generate a project-local verify-<app> skill (Launch/Doctor/Drive/Evidence/Cleanup + feature map); amillez-mode overlay
Audit/keep a project verify-<app> skill and feature map honest
Thin setup-pstack replacement: policy chooser + install/update Claude/Codex rules templates (do not write pstack-models.mdc or Cursor rules)

vendor.note: No public skills-lock upstream — refreshed manually from a machine with current Codex skills (see README). Copy into projects via add-project-skills.sh when needed.
